title: fix(permissions)!: an absent CRUD bit on a /me/permissions row denies New, Edit and Delete
body:
Fixes #26193

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — the console no longer offers Create / Edit / Delete when `/me/permissions` serves an object row that omits the bit. That is exactly when the server refuses it, because the spec grants only on `=== true` (permission.zod.ts:196, :218). The anonymous default and the no-provider fail-open are unchanged.
Metadata-protocol: none

## What was wrong

The console offered New on object lists, and Edit / Delete on records, to users who hold no Create, Edit or Delete grant, for example an auditor (read + View All) or a read-only finance user. They filled in the form and the server refused the save with 403.

The input that answered "allowed" was the permission provider's polarity. `MePermissionsProvider.check` (behind `usePermissions().can`, which `resolveAffordance('listNew')` asks) and `checkField`'s object-level fallback read a served object row with `bit !== false`. The server serves only the bits a set grants. Its plain-wildcard coverage (`materializePlainWildcardCoverage` in core `effective-object-permissions.ts`) copies only `true` bits, so a read-only `'*': { allowRead: true }` set is served as `{ allowRead: true }`, and an auditor's row as `{ allowRead: true, viewAllRecords: true }`. The absent `allowCreate` read as allowed on the client and as no grant on the server, which decides through the spec's `objectPermissionGrants` (`=== true`, plus the super-user bypasses).

The card's two suspected causes are ruled out on `origin/main`, as the claim's premise says. (1) Loading: the provider renders only its fallback until data arrives, and `check` fails closed without data. (2) View All cascading: `check` maps `create` to `allowCreate`, never to `viewAllRecords`.

## The change

`ui/packages/permissions/src/MePermissionsProvider.tsx`:

- `check` reads a served row through `objectPermissionGrants` from `@objectstack/spec/security`, the same fold the server's `PermissionEvaluator.checkObjectPermission` decides from. A bit grants only when it is `true`. Modify All Records also grants edit and delete, and View All Records also grants read. Nothing grants create except `allowCreate: true`.
- `checkField`'s object-level fallback (no field entry) asks the same fold for `allowRead`, `allowCreate` or `allowEdit`.
- `check` matches the object key case-insensitively first, as `checkField` already did.
- Unchanged: an anonymous session (`authenticated !== true`) keeps the permissive default, a tree with no provider keeps `can: () => true`, an object the response does not mention is still denied for a signed-in user, and explicit field-level entries answer as before.

## Reproduction (before / after)

Measured at `ccd94f7b` (the fix plus both pin files). The provider at `BASE` `df8aac41f2` was restored into the tree (on-disk hash `9ab00a25…` equals the base blob), then restored to `HEAD` (hash `6cf0d345…` equals the HEAD blob) under a trap.

- **Before:** `Tests 15 failed | 57 passed (72)`. The failures include `listNew` allowed for both the read-only `'*'` fixture and the auditor fixture, `recordEdit` / `recordDelete` allowed for both, `check` allowing every write action, `checkField` allowing create and write, and the `affordanceGrantMap-12082` auditor shape failing all four of its checks.
- **After:** `Test Files 3 passed (3) · Tests 72 passed (72)`.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/permissions/src/__tests__/MePermissionsProvider.absentBitDenies-26193.test.tsx`: read-only `'*'` and auditor fixtures (`check` and `can` deny create, update, delete and import with `denied-by-permission-set`, read and export stay allowed, and `checkField` denies create and write). Also the spec fold (Modify All grants edit and delete but not create; a Create-only row grants only Create), case-insensitive keys, and controls (explicit `true`, anonymous, no provider).
- New `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/listNewAbsentCreateBit-26193.test.tsx`: the `resolveAffordance('listNew')` verdict, plus `recordEdit` and `recordDelete`, through the real provider and the real map, on both fixtures. Controls: a user holding Create still gets New, and with no provider New stays fail-open.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx`: a fifth grant shape, `auditor (write bits absent)`, so every map row and every field row is held under it.

**Existing fixtures that needed explicit bits: none.** At `2dcfe6e5`, all 131 test files that mount `MePermissionsProvider` or read `effectiveObjects` passed unchanged (`Test Files 131 passed (131) · Tests 1666 passed (1666)`), and so did the 45 further test files that reach `/me/permissions` through other paths (`Test Files 45 passed (45) · Tests 515 passed (515)`). Every existing fixture already spelled its bits out.

Local runs, all under `os-verify-lock.sh`:

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/permissions type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check`: exit 0.
- At `c95c1986`: `vitest run packages/permissions/ …listNewAbsentCreateBit-26193 …affordanceGrantMap-12082`: `Test Files 15 passed (15) · Tests 212 passed (212)`. The commits after it are the manifest record and a merge of `origin/main`, which touches none of these files.
- `eslint` over the four changed source and test files: exit 0.
- `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`: 1 of 27 records re-recorded (`permissions`), artefact unchanged. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0.

## Gates (head `1c888a6e`)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 47 families. 46 exited 0. `pnpm check:type-check-debt` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: its closure build never got a turn on the shared verify lock), so it is **NOT MEASURED** locally, and CI runs it. `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ 47 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 46 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`.

Dogfood battery (owed for the `(narrowing)` arm): **NOT MEASURED** when this PR opened, because the shared lock's queue had not reached it. The reading goes in the card's `os-dev-report` comment.

## Acceptance notes

- `check('export')` still maps to `allowRead`, while the server's export grant is `allowExport ∧ read` (the spec fold's `allowExport` cell). This is dormant: no production reader in `ui/` calls `can(…, 'export')` (the list and grid Export buttons read the effective API operation set). Noted, not filed. Carrier: none.
- `current_user.can()` in `@object-ui/app-shell` reads the response's `objects` map through `@objectstack/formula`'s `toEvalPermissions`, not through `check`, and this PR does not touch it.
